Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been feeling very confused and I’m not able to explain things clearly. I also have had a high temperature and some discomfort in my right upper belly area.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. **One question at a time**:

**When did the confusion start (hours vs days), and has it been getting steadily worse or coming and going?**
Patient: The confusion started about two days ago, and it has been getting steadily worse rather than coming and going.

Thank you. **One more focused question:**

**Do you have any vomiting, yellowing of the eyes/skin (jaundice), or dark urine?**
Patient: I haven’t noticed any vomiting, but I’m not sure about yellowing of my skin or eyes. I can’t say for certain whether my urine looks darker.
